name: Inland Sea
description: Dive site in the Dwejra Inland Sea (Qawra tad-Dwejra). The lagoon itself is about 2 m deep. An 80 m tunnel through the cliff leads to the open sea, from 3 m on the lagoon side to 26 m at the seaward end; outside, the seabed keeps dropping past 40 m.
conditions: Watch out for the tourist boats that use the tunnel.
